name: Jumping in the City
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create a completely new final square 1:1 mobile game launcher icon for "Jumping in the City", using the attached images as authoritative art references.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1: exact protagonist identity, face, clothing, anatomy, hair and materials. Preserve this handsome ADULT man's tan skin, brown eyes, tousled dark-brown hair, light stubble, charcoal hoodie with hood DOWN and sleeves pushed to forearms, white undershirt hem, dark below-knee cargo pants with yellow straps and pocket tabs, black/yellow wristband, white socks, black-and-yellow sneakers with white midsoles.
Images 2 and 3: exact city visual world, architecture, weather, color grading and material quality. Match their believable semi-realistic premium 3D game art: weathered pale concrete rooftop terraces, mustard-yellow safety rails and ladders, gray rooftop equipment, touches of climbing greenery, dense modern blue-gray glass and concrete towers, a sunlit river winding between buildings and distant blue mountains. Blue sky with soft white clouds, warm golden late-afternoon sunlight and natural atmospheric haze. The city must look like these references, not a different stylized metropolis.

COMPOSITION:
An epic cinematic action close shot from a camera just beside the destination rooftop, at approximately the runner's knee height. The same protagonist is mid-leap over the rooftop gap toward and slightly across the camera, face clearly visible in three-quarter frontal view. Powerful forward momentum, one knee lifted, opposite arm bent naturally, trailing leg folded behind, balanced credible parkour posture, focused determined gaze at the landing. Entire head, hands and both sneakers visible with safe margins. Group the limbs compactly, avoiding outstretched fingers near edges. One person only. His head, torso and leading knee occupy the central 70 percent of the square, with a powerful immediately readable silhouette. A wide but undistorted lens and restrained foreshortening; no giant shoe, hand or head.
Frame the leap with two pale-concrete roof edges at lower corners, a short unmistakable yellow safety railing segment and a small touch of rooftop greenery. Behind him show the actual detailed reference city, river, skyscrapers and distant mountains with convincing depth and height. Keep the skyline mainly behind the lower body and off to either side; the head and shoulders separate cleanly against light blue sky. The city remains visibly architectural and realistically textured, not flat silhouettes.

VISUAL FINISH:
Premium polished semi-realistic game key art that exactly matches the reference character and environments. Strong natural sunlight from upper left gives golden rim lighting to the dark hoodie and warm highlights to the concrete, with rich cool blue-gray shadows. Clear, well-lit recognizable face. Crisp character and foreground, progressively softer distant city through natural haze, cinematic depth without obscuring reference architecture. Restrained amber highlights against saturated blue sky, charcoal outfit and distinctive yellow accents. Dramatic yet believable, excellent visual hierarchy and strong readability even when viewed as a tiny phone app icon.
Output the icon artwork only, square full bleed, opaque. No text, logos, letters, title, UI, mockups, decorative borders or pre-rounded corners. No neon-yellow backdrop, monochrome yellow sky, flat silhouette city, cartoon/anime redesign, orange shirt, costume change, extra people, motion blur on the protagonist, excessive lens flare, impossible acrobatics, or anatomy defects.
